operations.text: 0.3.17 writes into the skills, the Writer brief template and two recipes the sentences the loop had been carrying as local habits. In /pnp:qa the E2E report is copied by whoever ran the suite - the COO at the handoff, /pnp:qa itself after a scoped re-run - right after the run and before anything else, to <scratchDir>/<REF>-e2e-report-<N>.json, and the runner's output directory is neither deleted nor run over again before that copy stands; the QA brief, the review pack of /pnp:review and the QA recipe name that copy. /pnp:setup says that in an auto-approving permission mode the host may refuse the generator's write to .claude/settings.json or aiwf.config.json as self-modification, and that the generator then runs again in a mode that asks. /pnp:brief gains a step: when the state is durable - the ticket's record, the memory and the transfer surface complete - no brief is composed and the next session opens with /pnp:mission; a brief is composed only mid-flight, and the session brief recipe points to that step. In /pnp:plan the runnability pre-pass also checks that a command carrying a test filter selects at least one test - a filter that selects none is reported as cannot fail and treated like a command that cannot run, the check runs over the tree as it stands at the stamp, and a filter that names a test the ticket itself creates is exempt; a gate refusal, a command that cannot run and every revision go to the live planner by a message to the dispatched agent (SendMessage in Claude Code), a fresh dispatch with its dialog only when that agent has ended; the step on the roadmap entry asks the operator nothing, and its three questions - which real inputs exist, what must stay, what retires - are answered by the COO after the research, each written with its pointer into DECISIONS.md, only what stays unanswered going to the operator in one dialog before the decisions; and the approval report names the COO tier of each ticket, its COO line. The spec's RED run becomes a declared QA artifact: the Writer copies the JSON report of its own first, red run of the spec it adds to <scratchDir>/<REF>-e2e-red.json, or writes RED run: none - because <reason> when the pre-change tree could not be run; the Writer brief template carries that line for an E2E: yes ticket, and the QA brief and the QA recipe name the copy. This update re-renders no managed file and changes no config key: the skills, the recipes and the brief templates are read from the plugin root and arrive with the version. An overrides document or a stage file's project additions block that carries its own rule that the E2E report is copied out of the runner's output directory, or that the planning questions come after the research, may delete that rule on its operator's word: the payload now carries both.
